title: 第152章 宝箱
slug: 求生游戏请叫我诚信商人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【排行榜奖励发放中……】

【恭喜你获得第七试炼区积分排行榜第一，你将获得以下奖励：1滴翡翠源液、1个翡翠宝箱、3颗翡翠之心、灰烬余烬1000单位】

一道金光闪过。

李知面前出现一个金色礼包，正是对话框里显示的这些东西。

她点击查看最好奇的“翡翠源液”。

【翡翠源液：来自天启族翡翠的本源，也是进化之源，可用来提升非智慧种族血脉】

似乎没什么用……

李知将翡翠原野收到背包格子。

又将其他东西收好。

倒是也谈不上失望。

毕竟这个擂台第一也不是她本来的目标。

只是在赐福的加持下，再加上西莉亚一口一个翡翠喜欢她，她总是忍不住生出一些期待，希望能得到一些更好的东西。

好在翡翠之心还是很有用的。

她暂时是用不上，但翡翠之心的作用配合她即将卖出的攻略，绝对能让她即将开业的商铺再度火一把，说不定还能拍出天价！

叫我凤傲天倒是很开心，转头问李知：“你是不是也有一个箱子？你开了吗？我的是黄金宝箱，第一次开黄金箱子，竟然给我开出C级套装了！还有一把D级的刀！太赚了！”

李知这才想起自己下意识先把箱子收了起来，因为她已经习惯把所有箱子都拿给欧皇去开了。

但是……

李知又把箱子从背包里拿了出来。

今天她也得到了赐福，再加上她也确实没有开过翡翠宝箱，要不试一试？

赫纳那边传来一阵阵惊呼，似乎是开到了很有用的东西。

李知看了眼眼前翠绿的箱子，脑海里再次浮现西莉亚的“翡翠喜欢你”，决定任性一把。

说不定呢？

就算开不出她真正迫切想要的好东西来，开箱子本身就是一件愉悦身心的事情。

李知没再犹豫，直接将手放在箱子上，一个对话框弹出：

“是。”

翠绿色的光芒闪烁，新的对话框跳了出来：

【恭喜玩家获得：本源1枚、翡翠山脉领地永久划取权】

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

[Leaderboard rewards are being distributed...]

[Congratulations on ranking first in the points rankings of the seventh trial area. You will receive the following rewards: 1 drop of emerald source fluid, 1 emerald treasure chest, 3 emerald hearts, and 1,000 units of ash and embers]

A golden light flashed.

A golden gift bag appeared in front of Li Zhi, which was exactly what was displayed in the dialog box.

She clicked to view the most curious "Emerald Source Liquid".

[Emerald Source Liquid: The origin of emerald from the Apocalypse tribe, and also the source of evolution, which can be used to enhance the bloodline of non-intelligent races]

It seems of no use...

Li Zhi received the Jade Field into the backpack grid.

Put other things away again.

It can't be said to be disappointing.

After all, being number one in the arena was not her original goal.

But with the blessing and the fact that Celia liked her every emerald, she couldn't help but have some expectations, hoping to get something better.

Fortunately, the Emerald Heart is still very useful.

She won't be able to use it for the time being, but the function of the Jade Heart combined with the guide she is about to sell will definitely make her soon-to-open store popular again, and maybe even fetch a sky-high price!

He was very happy to call me Feng Aotian. He turned around and asked Li Zhi: "Do you also have a box? Have you opened it? Mine is a gold treasure box. The first time I opened the gold box, I was given a C-level suit! There is also a D-level knife! It's so profitable!"

Only then did Li Zhi remember that she had subconsciously put away the boxes first, because she was used to giving all the boxes to Ou Huang to open.

But...

Li Zhi took the box out of his backpack again.

She also received a blessing today, and she has indeed never opened an emerald treasure chest. Why not give it a try?

There were exclamations from Hena's side, as if he had found something very useful.

Li Zhi glanced at the emerald green box in front of him, and Celia's "Jade loves you" came to his mind again, and he decided to be willful.

Maybe?

Even if she couldn't find the good stuff she really wanted, opening the box itself was a pleasurable thing.

Li Zhi didn't hesitate anymore and put his hand directly on the box, and a dialog box popped up:

"Yes."

Emerald green light flashed, and a new dialog box popped up:

[Congratulations to the player for obtaining: 1 Origin and the permanent right to delimit the Emerald Mountain Territory]
